about: Capture-time provenance for docs/screens/*.png (#335). One row per shot, written by the session that took the pixels: sha256/canvas are properties of the bytes, origin/install/url/seed/level/layout/sampleRate/build are properties of the instrument and cannot be recovered from the PNG afterwards. `node tools/recap.js check` verifies each row against the file it addresses and against every other row of the same (seed, level, sampleRate); the vocabulary, the route verdicts and the audio-draw rule live in tools/recap.js, not here.
plan: Shared by all eight shots: window 1440x763 (device-metrics override at scale 1) on the deployed Pages build of main at 22ec109, at https://lioreshai.github.io/breach-protocol-flash-next/?dev=1&seed=60. One page load is one deal, so a re-take reloads the url and never calls a second DEV.boot() inside a load (js/90_dev.js:21-22); the dice is pinned by the page itself from `?dev=1&seed=` (js/90_dev.js:26). **Two terms this plan now records that the older rows could not.** (1) `DEV.freeze(true)` is issued the moment the page answers, BEFORE any boot or startLevel: the live update loop draws from the same seeded stream, so a page left painting while the harness polls re-deals levels 2 and 3 from wherever its clock happened to land. Measured for #478: three loads of the same url without the freeze signed level 2 as 350870494 / 1978041996 / 1812275020; with it, every load reads 1812275020. (2) `S.t = 4` is pinned before the shutter. A frozen clock stops update() but not S.t, and the exit portal is drawn with `globalAlpha = 0.5 + 0.35 * Math.sin(S.t * 5)` (js/40_render.js:3152), so where that overlay is in frame the frame mean is a function of wall-clock: ABATOIR CORE read 60.38 unpinned and 72.46 pinned, three pinned passes agreeing to 0.01. Then, per level: boot through the page's own load-time boot (level 0) or DEV.boot() + startLevel(N, true) (levels 2, 3), DEV.freeze(true); S.t = 4; DEV.tick(30); P.hp = 100; banner('', 0); then DEV.cam(...) and one DEV.tick(1) per shot. The level's own hostiles are left standing (never DEV.clear()), the one exception being level0-enemies, which clears and poses on purpose and is therefore shot LAST in its page load. Captures are Chromium screenshots re-encoded to colour type 2 by tools/png_rgb.js. Reproducible by statistics, never by md5. **The audio term.** SND.init draws floor(sampleRate*1.5) seeded values before genLevel (#404), and this capture profile exposed no audio device - SND.ac read null at every shutter - so every row carries `sampleRate: null` and binds the deal it names on a machine that draws the same zero count; `STRICT=1 node tools/recap.js check` prints the row as device-scoped. A capture that reads a rate narrows its row to one machine and one device.
